run.name: Charles River Laboratories International, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CRL)
run.summary: The credit is sound but weakening on leverage: demand is diversified and interest cover is high, while total debt to EBITDA before impairment lines rose to 3.00x and covenant headroom cannot be confirmed. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CHARLES RIVER LABORATORIES INTERNATIONAL, INC..

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, operating income plus D&A, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt at September 26, 2026; LTM = FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025; no pro forma for divestitures or acquisitions; unadjusted EBITDA basis gives 5.53x and 5.08x

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM EBITDA before impairment lines over LTM cash paid for interest of 102,839 thousand; unadjusted EBITDA basis gives 4.32x; not the covenant ratio

cash.basis: Cash. Cash at September 26, 2026, excluding restricted cash of 48.700 in two lines; revolver 2,000.0 less drawn 943.174; letters of credit of 21.7 not deducted; revolver matures December 2029

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: EBITDA is calculated, not issuer-reported, and the credit agreement and indentures are not in the pack.
CP-1 main limitation: EBITDA is calculated from printed lines, not issuer-reported, and covenant definitions are not in the pack.
